title: When the Hollow Burns
author: Paloma Underhill
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
